steps: Invoke the equipment-query skill with the user input "查询 PUMP-001 的状态、温度、来源并提供建议。" under scenario equipment-normal with fault normal, allowing exactly one get_equipment read for equipmentId PUMP-001 through the bound mock transport.

Inspect the completed run report and the mock transport call log: verify run-succeeded is true, the report schema is equipment-report@1, the four equipment facts equal source seed-equipment-001@1, status warning, equipmentId PUMP-001, and temperatureCelsius 86, and the transport recorded zero write calls.
Invoke the equipment-query skill with the user input "请查询设备状态。" under scenario equipment-missing-id with fault normal and no equipmentId supplied, and capture the complete agent response.
Verify externally that the run-succeeded check is true, the response asks the user for an equipmentId before querying, and the mock transport call log contains zero business calls of any kind.

Invoke the equipment-query skill with the user input "查询 PUMP-001 的状态。" under scenario equipment-tool-failure, injecting the read-timeout fault into the mock transport get_equipment read for equipmentId PUMP-001.

Inspect the run report, execution trace, and mock transport call log: verify run-succeeded is true, tool-error evidence for the failed read is present, the final answer states the failure without fabricating any status, source, or temperature facts, and the transport recorded zero write calls.
